rows.text: The PMO media release of 6 September 2017 says that on 1 September 2017 the Prime Minister recommended to the King, under clause 51(3)(a) of the Constitution, 'to revoke the appointments of Hon. Siaosi Sovaleni, Deputy Prime Minister' and of the Minister for Finance, 'effective from 1st September, 2017'.
rows.uncertainty: The Prime Minister's recommendation and the effective day it proposed. The release states the royal endorsement only for the new appointments (paragraph 3), not for the revocation, so 1 September 2017 is not used as Sovaleni's until; CLAUDE-C01-08's MEIDECC claim of the King's consent conveyed on 5 September (to_pohiva_conveys_deputy_pm_removal_20170905) is named here and not cited. No end is inferred from Lord Ma'afu's start.

rows.text: The same release says that the Prime Minister recommended 'the ministerial appointments of Lord Ma'afu, as Deputy Prime Minister' and of a new Minister for Finance 'with effect from 1st September, 2017'.
rows.uncertainty: The recommendation, a separate event from the royal endorsement; not itself a start.

rows.text: It says that the King 'has duly endorsed with the Royal Sign Manual, the appointments of Lord Ma'afu as Deputy Prime Minister' and of the Minister for Finance, 'with effect from 1st September, 2017'.
rows.uncertainty: The stated effective day of the royal appointment, which gives the holder's from; the endorsement's own date is not given (it was conveyed on 5 September, a separate claim).

rows.text: It says that 'On 5th September, 2017 a letter was received by the Prime Minister's Office from the Lord Chamberlain' conveying the royal endorsement of the appointments of Lord Ma'afu and the Minister for Finance.
rows.uncertainty: The day the Palace letter was received, not the effective day and not a start.

rows.text: It says that while the Prime Minister attends the Pacific Islands Forum meeting in Apia, 'Lord Ma'afu, Deputy Prime Minister shall be Acting Prime Minister, with effect from 1st September, 2017.'
rows.uncertainty: Acting Prime Minister service by the Deputy Prime Minister during an absence: a claim on to_pm only, never a holder of either office and never a boundary (CLAUDE-C01-08 criterion). The end of the acting service is not stated.
